arabic text: ZINDAGI KA BHAROSA NAHIN, ZIKR E HAIDER KIYA KIJIYE
english translation text: LIFE IS UNCERTAIN - INVOKE THE NAME OF HAIDER (ALI)

arabic text: AAQIBAT BHI SANWAR JAYE GI, YEH FARIZA AADA KIJIYE.
english translation text: YOUR AFTERLIFE WILL BE ADORNED - FULFILL THIS SACRED DUTY

arabic text: MAR BHI JAYEIN TO MARTAY NAHIN, HUM TO KASRAT SE DARTE NAHIN
english translation text: EVEN IF WE DIE, WE DO NOT PERISH - WE DO NOT FEAR BEING OUTNUMBERED

arabic text: KUFR HAI AGAR WILAYAT-E-ALI, HUM KO KAFIR KAHA KIJIYE
english translation text: IF LOVE OF ALI IS DISBELIEF - THEN CALL US DISBELIEVERS.

arabic text: DAR PE AA KAR YEH SHABBIR KE, AIK RAHIB NE KI ILTIJA
english translation text: A MONK ONCE CAME TO SHABBIR'S (IMAM HUSSAIN’S) DOOR AND MADE A PLEA

arabic text: MAIN SAWALI HOON SHAH-E-ZAMAN, MUJKO BAITA ATA KIJIYE
english translation text: I AM A HUMBLE BEGGAR, O KING OF TIME - GRANT ME A SON.

arabic text: BUGHZ-E-HAIDER HAI BUGHZ-E-NABI, YEH NAJAASAT HAI SAB SE BARI
english translation text: HATRED OF HAIDER IS HATRED OF THE PROPHET - THIS IS THE VILEST IMPURITY

arabic text: JO ALI SE ADAWAT RAKHAY, DOOR US SE RAHA KIJIYE.
english translation text: WHOEVER BEARS ENMITY TO ALI - KEEP FAR AWAY FROM THEM.

arabic text: DO FAREEQON MEIN AIK HI, HAQ PE HOTA HAI AE DOSTO
english translation text: AMONG TWO OPPOSING SIDES, ONLY ONE STANDS ON TRUTH, MY FRIENDS

arabic text: KAUN JANG-E-JAMAL MEIN MAGAR, HAQ PE THA FAISLA KIJIYE
english translation text: SO WHO WAS ON TRUTH IN THE BATTLE OF JAMAL? - YOU DECIDE.

arabic text: YA ALI MUKHTAAR HAIN, ANBIYA KE MADADGAAR HAIN
english translation text: O ALI IS THE MASTER OF WILL - THE HELPER OF ALL PROPHETS

arabic text: JITNE MOMIN HAIN UQDA-KUSHA, UNKI HAAJAT RAWA KIJIYE
english translation text: ALL TRUE BELIEVERS IN NEED - HAVE THEIR KNOTS UNTIED THROUGH HIM.

arabic text: AAL-E-AHMED KE ZAKIR MUHIB, ZIKR GHAIRON KA KARTE NAHIN
english translation text: THE LOVERS AND SPEAKERS OF THE FAMILY OF AHMED (PBUH) - DO NOT SPEAK OF OTHER
